title: Enforcement; void marriage.
bodyText: If a marriage is determined to be void, an agreement that would otherwise have been a premarital agreement is enforceable only to the extent necessary to avoid an inequitable result.
bodyHtml: [§572D-7]  Enforcement; void marriage.  If a marriage is determined to be void, an agreement that would otherwise have been a premarital agreement is enforceable only to the extent necessary to avoid an inequitable result. [L 1987, c 321, pt of §1]
